ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent allegations of Medicaid fraud in California and Minnesota, and track the federal government's response to the issue
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in California and Minnesota?
How is the federal government responding to the issue?
ideas.insight: This story idea has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight in the Medicaid program. I recommend starting with a review of the recent investigations and allegations, and then tracking the federal government's response to the issue.
